notes.title: Ver.1.1.3 Released
notes.content:
Ver.1.1.3 has been released.
- Improved PVC texture

Note
  After updating from Ver.1.1.1, if you load the save data, it may start from a different scene.
  To inherit the save data certainly, back up the following data before the update and 
  overwrite them in the same location after the update.
  Steam/steamapps/common/Escalation!/Escalation!_Data/Savedata

  It is expected that this issue will not occur after this update.
  We apologize for the inconvenience only once. Thank you.

  Contents of Ver.1.1.2 are included in this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39865261/dcd9e9c02cb18cb239a0c99e9e396a028f752cb8.png[/img]
